name: Tarnished Idol of Good Fortunes

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: +1 AC while attuned; once a day the idol speaks an Augury; it turns trade goods into coin.
text: While attuned to this idol you have a +1 bonus to AC. Once per dawn you can cast Augury from it; the idol speaks the omen. While holding it, as a Magic action you can turn a nonmagical trade bar or gemstone you touch into coins of equal value.

powers.name: Augury

params.text: whispers an omen about the plan you describe: weal, woe, both or nothing

powers.text: Once a day: Augury, spoken by the idol.

params.text: turns a trade bar or gemstone you touch into coins of the same worth (the game counts your gems as coin already)
